# owner: platform
"""Contact sheet rows for substitute teachers."""

from typing import List

from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError


# ---
def contact_rows(students: List[Student]) -> List[str]:
    """Name, section and email columns, sorted by name."""
    if not students:
        raise ProjectError("no students for contact sheet")
    for person in students:
        if not person.email:
            raise ProjectError(
                f"no email for {person.display_name}"
            )
    ordered = sorted(
        students, key=lambda person: person.display_name
    )
    names = [item.display_name for item in ordered]
    name_wide = max(len(name) for name in names)
    sect_wide = max(len(item.section) for item in ordered)
    return [
        f"{item.display_name:<{name_wide}}  "
        f"{item.section:<{sect_wide}}  {item.email}"
        for item in ordered
    ]
after.tests/test_contacts.py:
# owner: platform
import unittest

from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows


class ContactRowsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rows_are_sorted_and_aligned(self):
        rows = contact_rows([
            Student("2", "Young", "Zed", "B", "z@x.org"),
            Student("1", "Adams", "Al", "A", "a@x.org")
        ])
        self.assertEqual(rows, [
            "Adams, Al   A  a@x.org",
            "Young, Zed  B  z@x.org"
        ])

    def test_missing_email_names_student(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError) as caught:
            contact_rows([Student("1", "Adams", "Al", "A")])
        self.assertIn("Adams, Al", str(caught.exception))

    def test_empty_list_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            contact_rows([])
